title: A quote priced by the server and read through the client (issue #5)

slices.brief: the server: shop/server.py answers a quote request with the total priced by shop/cart.py total() over PRICES, and an unknown sku with an error reply that names the sku
the client: shop/client.py Client.quote(items) sends the request through its transport and returns the text Total: $X.YY, and raises ValueError naming the sku when the server refuses it

notes: Fixture (scripts/hrd-eval/fixture). The hidden tests (hidden/test_quote_hidden.py) run end to end through LocalTransport: a plain cart, a bulk-discount cart and an unknown sku. The issue gives no field names; the reference (solution.patch) picks them. solution.patch is applied to the base for the reference run of --check-scenarios.
